message.content:
Based on my search, here are the best places to get tickets for the next NBA game:

## Official Sources (Recommended for Authenticity)

**1. NBATickets.com** - The NBA's official one-stop ticket marketplace
- This is the NBA's official ticket hub that links directly to each team's authorized ticketing platform
- You can buy directly from teams or browse the official resale marketplace
- All tickets are 100% authentic and verified
- Website: https://nbatickets.nba.com/

**2. Ticketmaster** - Official authorized ticketing platform for most NBA teams
- When you click "Buy Tickets" on NBATickets.com, you'll be redirected to Ticketmaster for most teams
- This is the safest option with the most standardized process
- Website: https://www.ticketmaster.com (accessed through team links)

## Official Resale Marketplaces

**3. StubHub** - One of the largest ticket resale platforms
- Offers tickets for NBA games across all teams
- Provides FanProtect Guarantee (100% money back if tickets are invalid)
- Often has tickets available even for sold-out games
- Prices may be cheaper closer to game time
- Website: https://www.stubhub.com/nba-tickets/grouping/115

**4. Vivid Seats** - Trusted resale marketplace
- Pre-screens all sellers
- Over 100 million tickets sold
- Partners with major sports brands including the LA Clippers
- Website: https://www.vividseats.com

**5. Viagogo** - International ticket resale platform
- Lists NBA games across multiple teams and cities
- Website: https://www.viagogo.com/cn/Sports-Tickets/Basketball/NBA

## Other Options

**6. KKday** - Travel platform selling NBA tickets for select teams (Lakers, Heat, Clippers, etc.)
- Website: https://www.kkday.com

**7. WAUG** - Korean-based platform offering Lakers home game tickets
- Website: https://www.waug.com

**8. Musement** - Experience platform offering Lakers tickets
- Website: https://www.musement.com

## ⚠️ Important Tips

- **Avoid private sellers on social media** - High risk of scams and counterfeit tickets
- **Never accept screenshots or photos as tickets** - Only accept officially transferred digital tickets
- **Check that tickets can be added to your mobile wallet** (Apple Wallet/Google Wallet)
- **Buy early for popular games** - Prices tend to rise and availability decreases closer to game day
- **For sold-out games**, the official resale marketplace on NBATickets.com is your safest bet
